focus: New York metro depots on Long Island (Bay Shore, Middle Island) and in northern New Jersey (Linden, Carlstadt, Jersey City, Sussex)
intro: These New York listings were checked on operator-owned pages on November 21, 2026. The largest U.S. metro has no big RV depot inside the five boroughs, so pickups happen on Long Island or across the Hudson: Cruise America runs two Long Island depots in Bay Shore and Middle Island, El Monte RV and Road Bear RV share a depot in Linden, New Jersey, Indie Campers is in Carlstadt near the Meadowlands, two campervan brands list a Jersey City address, and 84 RV Rentals is out in Sussex, New Jersey. Winter hours are short — the Linden depot is closed Wednesdays and weekends until April — so check the day before you plan a weekend trip. Hours and flags are copied only from those pages. This is a starting sample, not a metro-wide inventory, and it does not cache live RV availability. Peer-to-peer platforms such as RVshare and Outdoorsy show live inventory for a specific weekend. If a price appears, it is labeled as listed on a date.

listings.name: El Monte RV — New York (Linden, NJ)
listings.area: Linden, New Jersey, about 10 miles from Newark Airport per the page

hours.notes: Current season (October 1–March 31) on the official New York page: Monday–Tuesday 9:00 AM–4:00 PM, Wednesday closed, Thursday–Friday 9:00 AM–4:00 PM, Saturday and Sunday closed. April 1–September 30: Monday–Friday 8:00 AM–5:00 PM, Saturday 8:00 AM–1:00 PM, Sunday closed. Holiday closures include Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day. Standard pickup is after 1:00 PM on weekdays; the page says after-hours pickups are not possible.

listings.offersNotes: El Monte RV’s official one-way page lists New York among its locations. Confirm the route and any one-way fee when you book.
listings.feeNotes: The official New York page lists a $1,500 security deposit due at pickup, as listed on November 21, 2026.
listings.visitNotes: The depot is in Linden, New Jersey, about 31.9 miles from JFK per the page. You pick pickup and drop-off time slots during online self check-in, which opens 30 days before arrival. No weekend pickups in the current season.
